meta.name: Diamonds: Three-Hand Vault
meta.blurb: Three hands of seven tricks: win tricks and play off-suit to move crystals into your showroom (1 point each) and vault (2 points each).

setup.label: the table is set
setup.text: Seats 1, 2 and 3 sit clockwise; the left of each seat is the next seat clockwise. Every showroom and vault starts empty.

steps.label: a new hand
steps.text: Hand {hand_number} of {hands} begins. Seat {dealer_seat} deals; seat {leader_seat} will lead the first trick.

steps.label: the deal
steps.text: Each player is dealt {cards_dealt_per_player} cards face down; the other {cards_set_aside} cards are set aside unseen for this hand.

steps.label: your hand
steps.text: Your hand, sorted by suit (D, H, S, C) and rank:

steps.label: pass a card
steps.text: Choose exactly one card from your hand to pass face down to the player on your left (seat 1 passes to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1). All passes happen at once and the third player never sees your card.

steps.label: the passes are exchanged

value.calc: [p.pass_card for p in players if p.seat % 3 + 1 == you.seat][0]

steps.text: Every player passes one card to the left at the same moment.

steps.label: your hand after the pass
steps.text: The card you received from your right and your hand now:

steps.label: lead a card

value.calc: [c for c in you.hand if c[0] == led_suit] if any(c[0] == led_suit for c in you.hand) else you.hand

steps.text: You lead this trick. Play any card from your hand; its suit becomes the led suit.

steps.label: second seat follows
steps.text: The led suit is {led_suit}. You are offered only the cards you may play: your {led_suit} cards if you hold any, otherwise any card. Playing off-suit gives you that card's suit action at once.

steps.label: second seat off-suit action

value.calc: 0 if act_suit != 'C' else (0 if max(players[actor % 3].showroom, players[(actor + 1) % 3].showroom) == 0 else (actor % 3 + 1 if players[actor % 3].showroom >= players[(actor + 1) % 3].showroom else (actor + 1) % 3 + 1))

Hearts action: seat {player} moves {crystals_per_action} crystal from the supply to their showroom.
Spades action: seat {player}'s showroom is empty, so nothing happens.

Clubs action: both opponents of seat {player} have empty showrooms, so nothing happens.

steps.text: Seat {actor} played off-suit and takes the {act_suit} action.

steps.label: third seat follows
steps.text: The led suit is {led_suit}. You are offered only the cards you may play: your {led_suit} cards if you hold any, otherwise any card. Playing off-suit gives you that card's suit action at once.

steps.label: third seat off-suit action

value.calc: 0 if act_suit != 'C' else (0 if max(players[actor % 3].showroom, players[(actor + 1) % 3].showroom) == 0 else (actor % 3 + 1 if players[actor % 3].showroom >= players[(actor + 1) % 3].showroom else (actor + 1) % 3 + 1))

steps.label: end of hand bonuses

Spades majority: seat {player} takes the Spades action and moves {crystals_per_action} crystal from their showroom to their vault.

steps.text: Hand {hand_number} is over. Suit majorities are resolved in the order Diamonds, Hearts, Spades, Clubs (a tie for the most means nobody takes it), then every player with no tricks takes the Diamonds action twice.

steps.label: final scoring
steps.text: Final scores (2 per vault crystal, 1 per showroom crystal): seat 1 {players[0].score} (vault {players[0].vault}), seat 2 {players[1].score} (vault {players[1].vault}), seat 3 {players[2].score} (vault {players[2].vault}).

rules:
Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3 clockwise; 'left' means the next seat clockwise. The deck has {deck_size} cards: {suits} suits (Diamonds D, Hearts H, Spades S, Clubs C), ranks {lowest_rank} to {highest_rank} in each. Each player has a showroom and a vault of crystals, both starting at 0; the supply is unlimited.

The game is {hands} hands of {tricks_per_hand} tricks ({total_rounds} tricks in all). In hand 1 the dealer is seat 1, in hand 2 seat 2, in hand 3 seat 3.

Start of each hand: all {deck_size} cards are shuffled and each player is dealt {cards_dealt_per_player} cards face down; the other {cards_set_aside} are set aside unseen. You see only your own hand, sorted by suit (D, H, S, C) and then by rank. Then everyone at the same moment secretly chooses exactly {cards_passed_per_player} card to pass to the player on their left; passes are exchanged at once and the third player is not told the card. Every player's tricks won and won cards of each suit are reset to 0.

Playing a trick: on trick 1 the player left of the dealer leads; afterwards the winner of the previous trick leads. The leader plays any card and its suit is the led suit. The other two play one card each, clockwise. If you hold a card of the led suit you must play one (you are only offered those). If you hold none, you may play any card and you immediately take the action of that card's suit, before the next player plays. All played cards are shown to everyone.

Winning a trick: the highest card of the led suit wins; off-suit cards never win. The winner takes the {cards_per_trick} cards, adds 1 to their tricks won and adds each suit's cards in the trick to their won count for that suit, then takes the action of the led suit once and leads the next trick.

Suit actions:
- Diamonds: move {crystals_per_action} crystal from the supply to your vault.
- Hearts: move {crystals_per_action} crystal from the supply to your showroom.
- Spades: move {crystals_per_action} crystal from your own showroom to your own vault. If your showroom is empty, nothing happens.
- Clubs: move {crystals_per_action} crystal from the showroom of the opponent whose showroom is largest into your own showroom. If both opponents tie for largest, take it from the tied opponent who sits first clockwise after you. If both opponents' showrooms are empty, nothing happens.
Every action and its result is announced to all players.

End of hand (after trick {tricks_per_hand}): for each suit in the order Diamonds, Hearts, Spades, Clubs, the player with strictly the most won cards of that suit takes that suit's action once; if the top count is tied, no one takes it. Then every player who won 0 tricks in the hand takes the Diamonds action {zero_trick_diamond_actions} times. The dealer passes to the left for the next hand.

Showroom counts are always displayed; every change to a vault is announced. Hands, passed cards and set-aside cards are hidden.

Scoring: after hand {hands}, your score is {vault_weight} times your vault crystals plus your showroom crystals. The highest score wins. If players tie for highest score, the tied player with more vault crystals wins; if still tied, they share the win as a draw.
